input.insight: The atlas release build gets cancelled by CI because it starts every release build with a cold (empty) cargo registry cache, which adds ~18 minutes of compile time on top of the normal build, pushing the total past CI's 30-minute hard cancellation limit; the fix is to add cache persistence for the release build job specifically (or as a fallback, raise its timeout) rather than accepting a cold build every release cycle.
